description: Use this when the user wants a depreciation calculator result for one asset: a straight-line depreciation schedule, double declining balance or 150% declining balance, sum-of-the-years' digits, units of production, or a MACRS depreciation calculator result for a computer, vehicle, equipment, rental property (27.5-year) or commercial building (39-year). Only cost is required; method, life or property class, salvage value and date placed in service are optional with stated defaults. Returns the year-by-year schedule (depreciation, accumulated depreciation, book value) to the cent, and PDF, Excel and CSV downloads. Does not model Section 179, bonus depreciation, ADS or dispositions, and is not tax advice. Do not use for several assets (use generate_depreciation_schedule).

business_use_percent.description: Business-use percent of the asset, e.g. 80 for 80%. Default 100. Basis and salvage are scaled by it.

convention.description: First-year convention. MACRS: half_year (default) or mid_quarter; real property always uses mid_month. Book methods: full_month (default, the month placed in service counts), mid_month, half_year or full_year.

cost.description: Required. Cost basis of the asset (purchase price plus sales tax, shipping and installation), e.g. 25000 or "$25,000". For a building, leave out the land value.

declining_rate.description: Declining balance rate in percent: 200 (default, double declining), 150 or 125.

land_value.description: Land value included in cost, e.g. 70000 for a house bought with its lot. It is taken out of the basis because land is not depreciable.

method.description: Depreciation method: straight_line (default), double_declining (200% declining balance), 150db, declining_balance, sum_of_years, units_of_production, or macrs (US tax, IRS Pub 946 tables). Synonyms like "DDB", "SYD", "tax" work.

name.description: Asset name or description, e.g. "Dell laptop" or "Rental house at 12 Oak St". Also used to pick a MACRS class or a default life when none is given.

placed_in_service.description: Date placed in service, e.g. 2026-03-15, "March 2026" or 03/15/2026 (US order). Only the month and year matter. Default January of this year.

property_class.description: MACRS GDS recovery period: 3, 5, 7, 10, 15, 20, 27.5 (residential rental) or 39 (nonresidential real property), or words like "residential rental", "computer", "office furniture".

salvage_value.description: Salvage (residual) value at the end of the life, e.g. 2000 or "10%". Default 0. Ignored by MACRS.

switch_to_straight_line.description: Declining balance only: switch to straight-line when it gives more depreciation. Default true.

units_per_year.description: Units of production only: units used each year starting with the year placed in service, e.g. [20000, 25000, 18000] or "20000, 25000, 18000".

units_total.description: Units of production only: estimated total lifetime units, e.g. 100000 (miles, hours or pieces).

useful_life_years.description: Useful life in years for book methods, e.g. 5 or "7 years" or "60 months". Default from the property class or the description, else 5.

name: calculate_depreciation
title: Calculate depreciation for one asset
